source_behavior: Incoming or internal transfers with the reception-report group expose Allocation; the reception_report client action shows source-demand lines and supports Assign, Unassign, Assign All, report print, and reception labels.
comparison: Core3 implements the bounded report context, deterministic demand lines, durable refresh/event history, Assign/Unassign/Assign All, and company/actor/stale guards. Live authenticated Odoo comparison is blocked by the login redirect.
